scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && tsc --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck 'api/[...path].ts'
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
